items.title: pearl at dusk
items.what: ground fountains lit up, string-light trees, old brewery chimney behind. just walk, watch the kid + dog chaos in the spray.
items.whyYou: you're a night owl + art person, this is your golden-hour photo walk. gabe calls it his saturday ritual.

evidence.caption: pearl at dusk. the ground fountains lit up, trees wrapped in string lights, a kid and a dog losing their minds in the spray, the old brewery chimney behind it all. saturday ritual. free to walk, $12 tacos if you cave #sanantonio #thepearl
evidence.sawLive: super chill at dusk, not crowded — just a few people around the lit fountains and string-light trees. free to walk around, and the caption says $12 tacos if you want food.

items.title: river walk, 20 mins max
items.what: stone bridge, purple-green lit trees, red-lit boat down the water. walk it at dusk then bail to pearl/southtown to eat, per lena + gabe.
items.whyYou: quick night-owl stroll for the lights, then food where your people actually eat.

evidence.caption: took my out of town cousin to the river walk against my will. dusk is the only acceptable time: stone bridge, trees lit purple and green, a boat with red lights way down the water. still not a fan but I get it for 20 minutes. go eat at the pearl after, don't eat down here

items.title: mission san josé slow morning
items.what: long wall of stone arches, two rows, green bushes, 300 years weathered. national park, quiet. light a candle if you want.
items.whyYou: for your art-people eye — arches, texture, cloudy-soft light. plus gabe's abuela cooks if you're lucky.
